selection_reasoning: The 'find blue_banner' task is a good atomic task for a single-task benchmark. A blue banner is a visually distinctive decorative item that can be placed in a Minecraft scene and is easily observable and verifiable. The agent needs to navigate the environment, visually identify the blue banner, and approach it. This task doesn't require deep Minecraft crafting knowledge — it's primarily a visual search and navigation task. It's straightforward to set up in a scene (place a blue banner somewhere the agent must find) and easy to verify completion (agent is near the banner's coordinates).

milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate/observe task. The player must navigate near the blue banner (placed on the east exterior wall of the spruce building at spawn-relative coordinates -6, 2, 6) and face toward it. max_distance=16 allows detection from a reasonable viewing distance, and facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is actually looking at the banner rather than facing away from it.

scene_description: A small village with three buildings (oak planks, cobblestone, spruce planks) arranged around a central cobblestone path. A blue banner is mounted on the exterior east wall of the spruce planks building in the northwest area. The player spawns at the center of the village and must explore to find and approach the blue banner. Hay bales and a barrel add visual interest, and a villager adds life to the scene.
task_text: Find the blue banner in the village. Look around the buildings and navigate to the blue banner.
design_notes: The blue banner is at ~-6 ~2 ~6 (on the east exterior wall of the spruce building, rotation=8 facing west). The player spawns at center (~0 ~0 ~0) on the cobblestone path. Distance to banner is approximately 9 blocks. Three buildings create visual complexity requiring exploration. The banner is visible from the center but requires navigation northwest to approach it. The spruce building has a door on the south side at ~-8 ~0 ~4.
